Compose Pi runtime configuration and daemon routing (#282)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-71
  description: |-
    ## Objective
    
    Make the completed Pi Operation Runner selectable and executable by the production Codeon daemon through strict configuration, bootstrap composition and routed lifecycle delegation.
    
    ## Owned scope
    
    - Raw/validated execution configuration for `[execution.pi]`.
    - Pi spawn-spec resolution.
    - Production Pi RuntimeAuthority construction.
    - Daemon runner composition and every routed lifecycle match.
    - Example configuration and focused config/bootstrap tests.
    
    Do not redesign Provider credential management, execution profiles, containment or Operation business handlers.
    
    ## Configuration API
    
    Add:
    
    ```toml
    [execution.pi]
    enabled = false
    executable_env = "CODEON_PI_EXECUTABLE"
    ```
    
    Required semantics:
    
    - Unknown fields are rejected.
    - When disabled, do not read the executable environment variable.
    - When enabled, `executable_env` must be a syntactically valid environment-variable name and its value must exist, be non-empty, absolute and executable.
    - Do not add Provider, base URL, API key, models.json, auth.json, runtime-home or Pi-profile fields.
    - Do not set `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`; use the daemon user's ambient `~/.pi/agent`.
    - Do not hard-code local Provider `ayn`.
    
    Routing examples must show both:
    
    ```toml
    [execution.agents.planning]
    kind = "pi"
    goal_mode = "recommended"
    ```
    
    and:
    
    ```toml
    [execution.agents.implementation]
    kind = "pi"
    model = "provider/model-id"
    reasoning_effort = "medium"
    goal_mode = "disabled"
    ```
    
    ## Bootstrap API
    
    Add `build_pi_runner` beside existing Codex/Cursor/Grok builders. It receives profiles, operation MCP URL, completion registry and dispatch/capability store needed by the Runner.
    
    Availability behavior:
    
    - disabled => runner None and bounded `reason=disabled`
    - missing/invalid executable prerequisite => runner None and `reason=prerequisite_unavailable`
    - valid adapter => runner Some and available=true
    - never print argv secrets, capability or Provider credentials
    
    ## Routed runner changes
    
    Extend production aliases and:
    
    ```rust
    DaemonAgentOperationRunner::routed(codex, cursor, grok, pi)
    RoutedAgentOperationRunner { ..., pi: Option<Arc<...>> }
    ```
    
    Add `AgentKind::Pi` to preflight, provision_runtime, dispatch_input, inspect, cancel, recover and completed-resource cleanup. A missing Pi runner maps through the existing unavailable runner; it must not fall back to Codex/Cursor/Grok.
    
    Update Debug/availability summaries with a boolean only.
    
    ## Operation phases
    
    Do not add a Pi-specific phase handler. Pi uses the existing deployed Planning, Implementation, Review and Revision handlers and the ordinary operation completion schema. Confirm the target branch's production handler registry at implementation time; do not resurrect an obsolete Planning-only gate.
    
    ## Trust and containment
    
    Spawn Pi with `--no-approve` and explicit embedded Extension. This prevents repository project resources from being trusted for the run. Do not claim cgroup/container/sandbox isolation unless separately configured by deployment. Pi's built-in tools retain their normal abilities.
    
    ## Tests
    
    - strict raw TOML and default values
    - disabled config ignores env
    - enabled missing/relative/non-executable path
    - valid absolute executable
    - routed selection for every lifecycle method
    - missing Pi runner never falls back
    - availability logging contains no model/key/capability
    - ProviderDefault and explicit model routing survive frozen binding/config snapshots
    - all four agent kinds remain selectable
    
    ## Definition of done
    
    A production daemon configured with `execution.pi.enabled=true` can select AgentKind Pi, construct the Pi Runner, execute every Agent lifecycle method and use existing phase handlers without Codeon owning Provider credentials.
    
    ## Reviewed dependency and handoff boundary
    
    - Blocked by: `fewensa-70`.
    - Blocks: `fewensa-72`.
    - Consume the Runner as implemented; this Task may add production type aliases and constructor wiring but must not redesign its state machine.
    - `[execution.pi]` has exactly two v1 fields: `enabled` and `executable_env`. Any request for runtime home, Provider, key, model catalog or profile configuration is out of scope and belongs to the future profile work.
    - The Issue-level model remains provider-qualified routing data; daemon configuration must not resolve or rewrite it.
    - Before completion, bootstrap tests must demonstrate that every lifecycle call selects Pi only for `AgentKind::Pi` and that unavailable Pi never falls back to another Agent.
